import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Arrays;
import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        new Main().execute();
    }

    public void execute() {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        long number = scanner.nextLong();
        System.out.println(compute(number));
    }

    long compute(long n) {
        int size = (int) 4e5;
        long[] upper = new long[size];
        long[] lower = new long[size];
        for (int i = 1; i < size; ++i) {
            lower[i] = i;
            upper[i] = n / i;
        }
        boolean[] primeFlags = new boolean[size];
        Arrays.fill(primeFlags, true);
        primeFlags[0] = false;
        primeFlags[1] = false;

        ArrayList<Integer> primes = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 2; i < primeFlags.length; ++i) {
            if (!primeFlags[i]) continue;
            primes.add(i);
            for (int j = i * 2; j < primeFlags.length; j += i) {
                primeFlags[j] = false;
            }
        }

        for (int index = 0; index < primes.size(); ++index) {
            int p = primes.get(index);
            for (int i = 1; i < size && n / i >= (long) p * p; ++i) {
                long val = (long) p * i;
                if (val < size) {
                    upper[i] -= (upper[(int) val] - (index + 1));
                } else {
                    lower[(int) (n / i / p)] -= (lower[(int) (n / i / p)] - (index + 1));
                }
            }
            for (int i = size - 1; i >= (long) p * p; --i) {
                lower[i] -= lower[i / p] - (index + 1);
            }
        }

        long answer = 0;
        for (long p : primes) {
            if (p * p > n) break;
            if (p * p * p <= n && p * p * p > 0) {
                ++answer;
            }
            if (n / p > p) {
                if (p < size)
                    answer += upper[(int) p] - lower[(int) p];
                else
                    answer += lower[(int) (n / p)] - lower[(int) p];
            }
        }
        return answer;
    }

    void trace(Object... objects) {
        System.out.println(Arrays.deepToString(objects));
    }
}
